role_repair_analysis.node_purpose: Let exactly the three specialist owners selected by Lead R1 reconsider only the material judgment surfaces challenged in their own workpapers.
role_repair_analysis.input_scale: One immutable prior workpaper, role-local reviewed context and one accepted Lead challenge for Cash, Operating or Value.
role_repair_analysis.required_outputs: One substantive revised natural workpaper draft per selected role, with the accepted feedback visibly resolved and no new evidence authority.
role_repair_analysis.schema_burden: The repair context carries the complete prior workpaper, accepted FeedbackReceipt and locked Evidence, NumericFact, relation and gap sets.
role_repair_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: These three repairs guard company-versus-AI cash scope, segment-versus-product profit attribution and the margin bridge behind value capture.
role_repair_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R3 successful workpapers used roughly ten to eleven thousand reasoning tokens plus visible output, while R4 proved all three exact repair contexts.
role_repair_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking-max with a 32000 generated-token ceiling because each repair requires real financial reconsideration rather than schema mapping.
role_repair_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One natural draft per role and zero retry; truncation, missing draft or scope drift consumes the attempt and preserves the prior valid workpaper.

role_repair_submission.node_purpose: Map each completed role-repair draft into the strict specialist Workpaper contract without re-authoring its financial judgment.
role_repair_submission.input_scale: One completed repair draft plus the exact repair submission view carrying prior workpaper, Lead feedback and locked reference authority.
role_repair_submission.required_outputs: One contract-valid repaired workpaper for each of Cash, Operating and Value with unchanged authority reference sets.
role_repair_submission.schema_burden: Nested claims, mechanisms, counterarguments, what-would-change and cross-role challenges must remain reference-bound and role-local.
role_repair_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A mapping change could erase a Lead correction or smuggle new support into a repaired conclusion, so every authority set remains fail-closed.
role_repair_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R4 completed strict Cash and Supply workpaper submissions and Lead R1 submission with the same non-thinking profile and zero schema drift.
role_repair_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA non-thinking submission profile because the financial analysis is already complete in the repair draft.
role_repair_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one Tool Call per repair and zero retry; invalid JSON, new references, identity drift or truncation fails closed.

lead_R2_coordination_analysis.node_purpose: Compare the three repaired workpapers with the three unchanged workpapers and decide whether the combined research may enter independent evaluation.
lead_R2_coordination_analysis.input_scale: Six validated role-local workpapers after exactly three accepted repairs and the deterministic cross-role challenge catalog.
lead_R2_coordination_analysis.required_outputs: One materiality-ranked coordination decision that either proceeds, pauses for data or identifies a still-unresolved catalog-bound challenge.
lead_R2_coordination_analysis.schema_burden: Lead may select only visible challenge identifiers and cannot author financial facts, numbers, citations or cross-role replacements.
lead_R2_coordination_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: A false proceed would hide unresolved L1 attribution conflicts, while an unnecessary repair loop would overfit the Harness and waste calls.
lead_R2_coordination_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R4 Lead R1 naturally identified exactly three current-evidence repairs and deferred all requests requiring new data to the Evidence Gate.
lead_R2_coordination_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking-max with a 32000 generated-token ceiling for cross-role comparison and materiality judgment.
lead_R2_coordination_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One natural Lead R2 draft and zero retry; truncation or an off-catalog decision preserves the frontier without declaring evaluation readiness.

lead_R2_coordination_submission.node_purpose: Map the completed Lead R2 judgment into the strict catalog-bound coordination decision without changing its routing decision.
lead_R2_coordination_submission.input_scale: One Lead R2 draft and the exact deterministic challenge identifier catalog derived from the six post-repair workpapers.
lead_R2_coordination_submission.required_outputs: One valid accepted/deferred challenge set, rationale and internally consistent next state with locally bound Lead identity.
lead_R2_coordination_submission.schema_burden: Accepted challenge identifiers must be unique catalog members and the next state must match the remaining material work.
lead_R2_coordination_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A submission error could falsely declare readiness or route an unauthorized repair, so invalid output remains terminal.
lead_R2_coordination_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R4 Lead R1 strict submission completed with tool_calls under the same non-thinking profile and preserved the natural routing judgment.
lead_R2_coordination_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA non-thinking submission profile because this node performs only strict decision mapping.
lead_R2_coordination_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one Tool Call and zero retry; invalid identifiers, inconsistent state or truncation fails closed and cannot be repaired locally.

It forbids completed Provider-node reruns, new research directions, retries, external acquisition, Candidate promotion, pointer mutation, Harness-authored judgment, Writer, publication, S3 acceptance, generalization and release.
